headline: Robust growth continues; best is yet to come

highlights: EBITDA grew 119% YoY to INR 563mn (+15% QoQ), largely driven by the strength in Aerolloy Technology (ATL) and a gradual recovery in TARC.
Post that, the next few years could be a phase of approval and order build-up (recently won a couple of orders from Safran and Airbus), followed by an exponential growth phase backed by execution.

Given that the Indian aerospace ecosystem is at an inflection point and ripe for 10x growth within a decade, material/machine parts supply ecosystem could be the biggest beneficiary, considering the current global supply tightness.

Robust earnings growth PTCIL's Q2FY27 revenue of INR 2.2bn was up 80% YoY/17% QoQ, driven by a 214% top-line growth in Aerolloy Technologies (ATL), alongside a gradual turnaround in TARC’s performance.
valuation: We are introducing our FY29E estimates with this report and also shifting the valuation multiple to FY29E.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Key risks • Delay in commissioning/ramp-up of new capacity. • Product development, approvals, and sales execution are lengthy and expensive processes.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
